messages.text: I’m sorry, but the rejected request does not keep the refund window open. The policy only provides an exception for an earlier on-time proposal that expired or became invalid before payment; a proposal rejected by staff does not qualify. The assessment shows there was no earlier on-time proposal for your cushion, so I can’t make a new proposal for it now. (refund-policy/v2/window)
